Tired of your 125 idle sound sounding like an air cooled Maico 700?

Then put this sweet sounding idle goodness on your favourite 125!

Please follow all instructions carefully. You MUST already have Beyers killer sound mods installed for this to work. Search MXB mods and follow Beyers instructions to download and install if you dont have them.

I dont have a preview or video file but think Factory PC KX125 vibes. Will work with ANY 125 as long as you install into each 125 bike folder. If you dont have specific bikes folders, and only have pkz’s, you will have to create the folders.

Download all files and put them on your desktop. Copy the engine.scl and sfx.cfg and paste into your preferred 125 folder using the folder location below. You will have to install this into each 125 bike folder if you want to use on more than one bike.

 

Copy the .wav file and paste into the folder location below:

 

DISCLAIMER: I rarely come into MXB Mods these days so if you have an problems or issues installing, please seek out someone that may be able to help as chances are I wont be available.

Welcome to Bakers Beach.

 

Layout is based off a hidden sandy practice track in north Scottsdale – Tasmania. Continuing the theme of Tasmanian coastal bush, animals and sand. Featuring 24 gates, multiple lines on each corner, on-offs, booters, some section-clearing hucks and a bonus turn track.

 

This track can be enjoyed on any bike from the Classic 125 2-strokes, up to the 450s. Lap times are short, generally between 1:05-55 secs.

 

Thanks to the guys in EE discord for your wisdom and kindness always.

Objects:

Tyres – Erect Erections

Trees – Steezy 

 

I strongly recommend chucking on Reshade and don’t forget to bring an extra jerry can of fuel. See if you can find all 12 animals hidden around the map. I will doordash or uber a cheese burger to whoever holds the fastest lap on December 1st.

 

Enjoy!

Toro Loco Freestyle Ranch 
Welcome to the biggest and most realistic FMX map ever made in MX Bikes. My greatest creation so far — built for pure style, flow, and insane freestyle sessions.

Main Features:

  • Foam Pit – perfect for learning and sending new tricks safely.

  • Speed Style track – fast, technical, and full of rhythm.

  • Complete FMX Course – big lines, natural terrain, and massive gaps.

  • Camp track with airbags – train and progress without limits.

  • Syncro ramps & Cheater frontflip ramps – for those wild combos.

  • Next Gen Kickers and 22-meter ramps – precision and power.

  • Bus jump over 35 meters long – the ultimate challenge.

  •  Multiple flow lines to keep the session going non-stop.

 Built with passion and detail to give you the most authentic FMX experience possible in MX Bikes.
This is Toro Loco Freestyle Ranch — where limits don’t exist.

Track Description – “Tour de Tilapia”
Built by Patron, Tour de Tilapia is a nighttime motocross track that delivers a one-of-a-kind riding experience. Set beneath glowing lights and surrounded by the sounds of nature, the track flows through deep ruts, big floaty jumps, and wide sweeping corners that challenge both precision and momentum.

The heart of the track—the section everyone talks about—is the underwater tunnel. Riders charge down into a glass-covered passage beneath the surface, surrounded by rippling blue light and schools of glowing tilapia drifting past. It’s the life of the track, a surreal, adrenaline-filled moment that breaks up the rhythm and leaves a lasting impression.

With its smooth flow, creative obstacles, Tour de Tilapia captures the perfect blend of motocross grit and aquatic fantasy
